Captains & Batters: Ruturaj Gaikwad (C), Sarfaraz Khan, Dewald Brevis, Ayush Mhatre, Rahul Tripathi, Shaik Rasheed, Andre Siddarth.
Wicket-keepers: MS Dhoni, Sanju Samson, Urvil Patel, Kartik Sharma, Vansh Bedi.
All-rounders: Shivam Dube, Ravichandran Ashwin (returned), Vijay Shankar, Jamie Overton, Matt Short, Aman Hakim Khan, Zak Foulkes, Prashant Veer, Deepak Hooda.
Bowlers: Khaleel Ahmed, Noor Ahmad, Mukesh Choudhary, Nathan Ellis, Shreyas Gopal, Gurjapneet Singh, Akeal Hosein, Matt Henry, Rahul Chahar, Anshul Kamboj, Ramakrishna Ghosh. 

Notable Former Players (2008–2025)
These players were instrumental in CSK's five title wins (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023):
Indian Stalwarts: Suresh Raina (all-time leading run-scorer for CSK), Ravindra Jadeja (traded to RR in 2026), Murali Vijay, Subramaniam Badrinath, Ambati Rayudu, Lakshmipathy Balaji, Ashish Nehra, Shardul Thakur, Deepak Chahar.
Overseas Legends: Michael Hussey, Matthew Hayden, Albie Morkel, Dwayne Bravo (former bowling coach), Faf du Plessis, Shane Watson, Muttiah Muralitharan, Brendon McCullum, Imran Tahir, Sam Curran, Devon Conway.
Other Key Contributors: Moeen Ali, Mitchell Santner, Maheesh Theekshana, Tushar Deshpande, Ajinkya Rahane, Robin Uthappa, Mohit Sharma, Doug Bollinger. 

The Inaugural 2008 Squad
The foundation was laid by these players in the very first season:
Captain: MS Dhoni
Batters: Suresh Raina, Matthew Hayden, Michael Hussey, Murali Vijay, Subramaniam Badrinath, Abhinav Mukund, Arun Karthik, S. Anirudha.
All-rounders: Albie Morkel, Jacob Oram, Joginder Sharma, Vidyut Sivaramakrishnan.
Bowlers: Muttiah Muralitharan, Makhaya Ntini, Manpreet Gony, Lakshmipathy Balaji, Shadab Jakati, Palani Amarnath, Sudeep
